name: Compile: Main 1

categories.label: Compiled all 3 protocols (winner)
categories.hint: First player to flip all 3 of their Protocol cards to the Compiled side wins.

categories.label: Protocols compiled
categories.hint: Count of your Protocol cards on the Compiled side (0-3).

winCondition: At the Check Compile step, a line with 10 or more value and more than the opponent's value in that line must be compiled; the first player to compile all 3 of their protocols wins. Recompiling a line does not count as a new protocol.

endCondition.description: First player with all 3 Protocol cards on the Compiled side wins.

notes: family: race. No points; the value in a line only triggers Compile. Simultaneous victory is not described in the rulebook (compiling is the only action of a turn, so only one player can finish per turn). Aux/Main 2 expansions not modelled.
